item.title: US targets mine-laying vessels in the Strait of Hormuz amid disruption of oil traffic
item.summary: Pentagon zeroing in on mine-laying vessels that are helping Iran keep a stranglehold on Strait of Hormuz, military leaders said, as markets feel pain from its closure.

item.title: WATCH: Trump compares US strike on Iran to Pearl Harbor

item.summary: The trooper in Mamaroneck was injured during a traffic stop when a SUV slammed into his patrol car, pushing it into another vehicle and hitting him. The incident is under investigation.
